body:
FOUND AT T109 (#269), flagged there as out of scope: `Gateway.health()` returns `StoreHealth` (with `SlateHealth`/`ForgivenHealth` inside), none exported from `src/index.ts`. Same defect as T82 (container surface) and T109 (slate surface), third door: a package consumer can call `health()` and cannot name what it answers. This was already noted once at T82's own landing ('Gateway.health() still returns an unexported StoreHealth') and left as a decision — T109 makes the pattern a rule, so close it.

Apply T82's disciplines verbatim, as T109 did: export the report TYPES (not any Impl), extend the surface rail (a new file if the T82-frozen `index-surface.test.ts` cannot be touched — check rails-guard), negative-probe an Impl, and sharpen any capabilities-book claim that names `Gateway` as the health door if a named export now fits better. Small, repair-tier, self-merge on green + P5 + the negative probe. Trivial enough to fold into the next surface-touching PR if one is open, but it earns its own shard so the 'three doors, one defect' story is on the record.
title: Gateway.health()'s StoreHealth / SlateHealth / ForgivenHealth are unexported — T82's rule, third door
